title: Amelia | Three-piece beige-grey set with flowing cardigan and wide trousers
bodyHtml:
This versatile three-piece set brings effortless elegance to your wardrobe. The flowing cardigan drapes beautifully over a soft layering top, paired with relaxed wide trousers in a warm beige-grey palette. Light and breathable, it skims your silhouette without clinging, moving beautifully through your day from morning meetings to evening gatherings.

Why you'll love it

  • Mix and match the three pieces—wear the cardigan with jeans, the top with a skirt, the trousers with a shirt
  • Relaxed yet tailored fit that flatters every body shape and doesn't pull or cling
  • Lightweight and airy with natural texture, perfect for warm days and layering on cooler evenings
  • Neutral beige-grey tones pair effortlessly with virtually everything in your wardrobe
  • Boho-inspired sophistication without the fuss—refined and understated
  • Hard to find as a complete set; this is the versatile, timeless option you've been searching for
  • Works beautifully for weddings, garden parties, weekend getaways, dinners, and relaxed workplace settings
